name: Heart of Trespia
source:
Play as Ellaire, the newly crowned Queen of Trespia. On her coronation day, she sees the unhappiness of her people and slips out of the palace to discover the truth. 

Alongside her loyal friend Wyatt, her maid Delias, the daring bandit leader Gisella, and the mysterious Earl Reinhold, Ellaire embarks on a journey that will reveal the real state of her kingdom.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heart_of_Trespia]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
你将扮演特雷斯皮亚刚刚加冕的女王埃莱尔。加冕当天，她发现自己的子民并不幸福，于是悄悄离开王宫，决心查明真相。

忠实的朋友怀亚特、侍女黛莉娅丝、胆识过人的盗匪首领吉塞拉，以及神秘的莱因霍尔德伯爵陪伴埃莱尔踏上旅程，逐渐揭开这个王国的真实面貌。
